record.title: Elevated errors with search in Dots, ChatGPT Work, and certain ChatGPT thinking experiences

updates.body:
We’re aware of issues affecting search in Dots, ChatGPT Work, and some ChatGPT thinking experiences.

We’re investigating and will share updates here.

All affected services are operating normally again.

We’re sorry for the disruption, and we appreciate your patience.
